title: Primal Reset Retreats | Men’s Retreats in Hawaiʻi
description: Men’s retreats on Hawaiʻi Island combining supportive coaching, movement, and meaningful connection. Explore Primal Reset and find your next step.

texts.value: Step away from the everyday. Find perspective through honest coaching, shared challenges, and a brotherhood of support on Hawaiʻi Island.

texts.label: You may look fine. That doesn't mean you feel fine.
texts.value: You may look fine. That doesn't mean you feel fine.

texts.label: You still work. You still handle your responsibilities. You still
texts.value: You still work. You still handle your responsibilities. You still show up. But divorce can quietly shake the way you see yourself.

texts.label: Maybe you hesitate around women, replay conversations, or wonder
texts.value: Maybe you hesitate around women, replay conversations, or wonder whether your confidence will return. Primal Reset gives you space to practice real connection and become comfortable being yourself again.

texts.label: Most men never get honest feedback from women
texts.value: Most men never get honest feedback from women

texts.value: In the Connection Lab, you practice a real conversation with a woman coach. She reflects your posture, voice, eye contact, pace, attention, and emotional presence. You make an adjustment, and then you try again.

texts.label: No scripts. No manipulation. No fake persona. No public humiliati
texts.value: No scripts. No manipulation. No fake persona. No public humiliation.

texts.label: Meet the women behind the feedback.
texts.value: Meet the women behind the feedback.

texts.label: A multidisciplinary team bringing experience in breathwork, welln
texts.value: A multidisciplinary team bringing experience in breathwork, wellness, movement, nutrition, counselling, and nervous-system regulation.

texts.label: Less talking about life. More living it.
texts.value: Less talking about life. More living it.

texts.label: Beach training, lava terrain, and physical challenge bring you ou
texts.value: Beach training, lava terrain, and physical challenge bring you out of your head and back into your body.

texts.label: Guided breathwork and cold-water practice create space between th
texts.value: Guided breathwork and cold-water practice create space between the pressure and your response.

texts.label: Small circles and honest exercises make room for the story beneat
texts.value: Small circles and honest exercises make room for the story beneath the polished version.

texts.value: Practice presence with women coaches, receive direct feedback, and leave with a circle that continues after you return home.

texts.label: Built on land that knows how to begin again.

texts.label: Open Gate is an off-grid basecamp set directly on cooled lava fie
texts.value: Open Gate is an off-grid basecamp set directly on cooled lava fields on Hawaiʻi Island's southeastern coast. Accommodations are simple and communal rather than resort-style, surrounded by volcanic earth, jungle, and ocean.

texts.label: A seven-day progression from arrival to a practical way forward.
texts.value: A seven-day progression from arrival to a practical way forward.

texts.value: Leave the noise behind. Meet the group, settle into the land, and name what brought you here.

texts.value: Move, breathe, enter cold water, practice confidence, and reconnect with what your body already knows.

texts.value: Step into honest feedback, wilderness time, and conversations that replace performance with truth.

texts.value: “Too many good men disappear into themselves when life falls apart.”

texts.label: Dan created Primal Reset after watching friends lose their confid
texts.value: Dan created Primal Reset after watching friends lose their confidence, connection, and momentum after divorce.

texts.label: His vision is a human-scale experience that invites men to listen
texts.value: His vision is a human-scale experience that invites men to listen without judgment, face challenges without humiliation, and build friendships that continue after everyone flies home.
